svg.title: Domestic cat
svg.desc: Standing gray domestic shorthair cat with tabby stripes, upright ears, flexible trunk, digitigrade limbs, and relaxed tail. Biological basis: Cats are used selectively in veterinary and comparative studies, including sensory, neurological, infectious-disease, and inherited-disease research.
